Documents when to collect telemetry metadata and what belongs in `metadataConfig`, with matching contributor guidance and review instructions.

- Collect default telemetry and supported telemetry modes, not regression-only disablement, adapter-fallback, or classpath compatibility variants.
- Treat `metadataConfig` as a telemetry label, not configuration or a copy of every test JVM flag. Include the non-default settings needed to describe the documented telemetry, including inherited settings.
- Explain how to exclude tasks from shared collection wiring and distinguish task names from default telemetry.

Existing Gradle task wiring is unchanged.

Addresses #20416.
metadata.title: Document telemetry metadata collection conventions
